availability.note: BYD AU configurator (bydautomotive.com.au/configurator/byd-seal 301-redirects here) lists exactly two variants, 'BYD SEAL Premium' and 'BYD SEAL Performance'; Dynamic dropped June 2026 per https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/byd-drops-its-cheapest-electric-sedan-in-australia

listPrice.note: configurator variant price $52,990 with GST component = price/11; drive-away is computed separately by postcode on top, so this is the list before on-road costs (structure, not words). CarExpert states $52,990 'before on-road costs' in words (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/byd-drops-its-cheapest-electric-sedan-in-australia, 25 Jun 2026); unchanged since the 13 Jan 2025 price cut

batteryKwh.note: BYD AU spec table 'Battery capacity 82.56kWh'. Treated as usable: EV Database gives 82.5 kWh usable / 84.0 kWh nominal for the same Blade pack (https://ev-database.org/car/2001/BYD-SEAL-825-kWh-RWD-Design)

rangeKm.note: BYD AU spec table quotes both 'Combined range NEDC 650km' and 'WLTP 570km'; NEDC rejected. WLTP matches EV Database's European figure for the same pack and drivetrain (https://ev-database.org/car/2001/BYD-SEAL-825-kWh-RWD-Design); both grades on 235/45 R19

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: EV Database WLTP rated consumption 166 Wh/km (manufacturer figure incl. charging losses); battery/range gives 14.5, 15% lower, consistent with charging losses

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 400 L rear seats up 'to lower window' (cargo-cover equivalent); 53 L frunk not added per owner convention

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: BYD publishes no folded figure. Cinch (UK) gives '~1,000 litres' seats folded; EV Database's 1,440 L maximum is unlabelled (likely to the roof). Held 950 kept as a belt-line estimate below Cinch's approximate figure

seats.note: five-seat sedan; body and seating unchanged in the AU line-up (BYD AU page dimensions and spec unchanged since 2025)

towKg.note: CarExpert spec page: 750 kg braked, 750 kg unbraked. BYD AU towing calculator is JS-only and the owner's handbook gives no rating. EV Database's EU RWD figure (1,000 kg) is a different market's homologation

warrantyYears.note: BYD AU: 'Vehicle Warranty - 6 years or 150,000 kms'; battery 8 years/160,000 km. Unconditional

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; anchored to byd-sealion-7-premium (1650 at $54,990) and below xpeng-g6-standard-range (1750 at $51,800); Tesla Model 3 rows run higher (2400 at $54,900) on Tesla's repair-cost profile

depreciationCurve.note: Changed from the held steeper [1,0.7,0.58,0.5,0.44,0.39] to the BYD brand convention used by most BYD rows (Seal 6, Sealion 5/6/7, Dolphin, Atto 1/2, Shark 6), per 'one depreciation curve per brand'. Seal prices have been stable since the January 2025 cut (CarExpert), so no Seal-specific evidence justifies a steeper curve
